title: The Crown of Ashvale Revisited
author: Rosalind Reyes
blurb: Wendell Blackwood, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
